abstract:
|
  Fix cycle round 2 on view train #69+#71, all 7 findings from
  artifacts/reviews/2026-07-27-view-69-71-review-r1-REJECT.md addressed,
  red-first, on car/view-69-71 base 256d8d5 through HEAD 2861bfd, 5 commits
  (3fa9b21, 97c3dc6, ca20830, d9ffcfe, 2861bfd), working tree clean.

  MAJOR-R1-1: renderSupersededDisclosure now appends the superseded block as
  a DOM CHILD of its owner row/chip (never a sibling of the shared grid/flex
  container), behind a collapsed-by-default details/summary disclosure - the
  conditions-strip idiom. Structural regression tests seed 5 subjects (the
  reviewer's own wrap-boundary recipe), observed red at base (10 direct
  children instead of 5), green after. Verified live in a real browser
  (recaptured screenshots, discInsideRow true observed). M1 (disclosed, not
  owner-ruled): the disclosure's open state is EPHEMERAL, never threaded
  through sessionStorage - minimal option, reasoning in
  docs/contracts/state-ledger.md's new disclosure paragraph, flagged here for
  reviewer adjudication.

  MAJOR-R1-2: new browser-conditions-persistence.test.js (real Chromium, real
  Go binary, browser-register-cascade.test.js's pattern) pins app.js:148's
  toggle listener. Non-vacuity: line removed (sha256 matched the review's own
  recorded value), observed red ("the strip closed across a real DOM rebuild
  ... false !== true"), restored byte-identical, green.

  MAJOR-R1-3: the false "untestable outside board/fold" claim corrected;
  TestAssembleDispatchRenderFailedIsReachable proves it reachable via real
  fold.Fold + mutating exported Spend to a channel + real Assemble(), non-
  vacuity proven by renaming the condition code and observing the assertion
  fail for the stated reason, then restoring byte-identical.

  MAJOR-R1-4: lanes.js's stale snapshot.go:41-45 line citation converted to a
  symbol citation (the Lane struct's doc comment, quoted verbatim) per
  gating-matrix.md:49's own already-landed lesson.

  MINOR-R1-1 (Law 6): store.RecordDirFromRelPath exported; assemble.go's
  recordDirBySubject calls it instead of inlining the identical rule: no
  duplicate rule remains between the two files. Refactor only, existing
  tests cover both call sites unchanged.

  MINOR-R1-2: schema/yard-snapshot.schema.json's superseded items are now
  type-constrained ({kind,at} both required strings via a new
  $defs.dispatchSupersededItem, $ref'd from both payloads); dom-writer.js
  guards the read (malformed items skipped, all-malformed renders absent,
  never empty) - non-vacuity proven by disabling the guard and observing
  both new tests red for the stated reason. Fallout fixed same-commit:
  scripts/tests/WirePayload.Tests.ps1's fragment-extraction helper did not
  carry sibling $defs, so the new $ref silently failed to resolve
  (Test-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue swallowed it) - fixed by wrapping
  the full $defs map into the extracted standalone schema.

  MINOR-R1-3: throwingStorage fake + two new tests pin both catch branches
  in condition-open-state.js. Non-vacuity: each try/catch removed in turn,
  observed red (uncaught SecurityError; uncaught QuotaExceededError via
  assert.doesNotThrow's own message), restored byte-identical both times,
  green.

  Final suite totals at HEAD 2861bfd: Go board/... 94 PASS / 0 FAIL (base 93
  + 1 new), go vet clean; Node board/web 208 tests / 208 pass / 0 fail (base
  200 + 8 new); Pester scripts/tests 223 passed / 0 failed / 4 skipped / 227
  total (matches base exactly - no new Pester tests added, two pre-existing
  regressions from the schema change were fixed in the same commit that
  caused them); Pester scripts/probes 24/24; probe-yard-snapshot.mjs PASS.
  All base counts re-derived by this car via git stash back to 256d8d5
  before editing, not assumed from the round-1 verdict.

  Disclosed: GitNexus detect_changes() could not be run - no GitNexus MCP
  tool was bound in this session's toolset and no .gitnexus/ directory
  exists in this worktree; not one of the 7 findings, honest-disclosed
  rather than silently skipped. No contradictions found between the brief/
  verdict and the real code at base - every finding's file:line evidence
  checked out as described.
